kanzAlMahalliRecord.statement: The reviewed Kanz/al-Mahalli record assigns one third to the mother when there is no child, son's descendant, or two siblings, and collectively to two or more uterine siblings; it separates the grandfather continuation from the ordinary rule.

khulasaSupport.limitation: No Khulasa research record, exact wording, locator, or bibliographic catalog entry for this rule is present in the repository. No quotation or page reference can be supplied.
